method: brace-aware lexical extraction preserving selector, declarations and enclosing @media context
limitations: Not a standards-compliant CSS AST parser; a PostCSS/CSS parser pass is still required.
Declarations are preserved verbatim and not normalized or cascade-resolved.
Third-party-origin rules are not attributed separately from AQ-authored rules.
Browser computed styles and compatibility are not inferred.

section,

audio,
canvas,
progress,
video,
picture

rules.declarations: background-color: transparent;-webkit-text-decoration-skip: objects; color: inherit; text-decoration: none;
